name: Existing-offer material recovery guard
scope: One fixed conjunction motivated by causal review of the first diagnostic. All1048 are development; no fresh accuracy claim.
eligibility: Existing S award; legal capturing move with no promotion, no check given and no check faced. Every qualifying offered piece is unmoved. Opponent's AFTER-position first root must legally accept a qualified offer in BOTH complete saved engine windows; no fallback to later PV moves. Roots may differ if both qualify.
existing_offer: Every qualified capture has same attacker/victim role/color on its squares and is legal with the same same-square exchange gain on a before-target clone with turn flipped to the opponent. This is a static geometric comparison, not a move or history event. Before-target en-passant is cleared; relevant victims are never pawns. Newly opened offers cannot be withheld.
recovery: Corrected probe: EVERY qualified acceptance has one legal noncapture/nonpromotion quiet response covering EVERY legal opponent reply with an explicit legal nonchecking nonterminal capture, valued by physical material minus maximum same-square recapture liability, within100 of pretarget balance. No actual-game or PV-only recovery certificate. No mate material sentinel or unstable raw stand-pat certificate.
validation: Apply to all1048 saved moves with S predictions; report exact changes to genuine and false awards by cohort, known external examples and unresolved proof coverage. No further parameter sweep or labels/IDs in the predicate. New-game confirmation required before generalization claims.
